description.zh: 先运行一段程序，再尝试修改输入和输出。
description.en: Run a small program, then change its inputs and output.

description.zh: 用独立小项目理解控制流、函数与数据结构。
description.en: Explore control flow, functions, and data structures through focused projects.

description.zh: 从缓冲收发，到任务汇总与处理流水线。
description.en: Move from buffered channels to worker fan-in and processing pipelines.

description.zh: 从空白入口或多个文件开始组织程序。
description.en: Organize a program from a blank entry point or multiple files.

description.zh: 观察有意制造的失败，再通过修改代码解决它。
description.en: Inspect intentional failures, then resolve them by editing the code.

description.zh: 浏览器 UI 预览接入后，窗口、控件与资源模板会归入这里。
description.en: Window, widget, and asset templates will live here when browser UI previews are available.

description.zh: 从入口函数和标准输出开始，修改文本后再次运行。
description.en: Start with the entry function and standard output. Edit the message and run again.

exercise.zh: 改写问候语，再运行一次。
exercise.en: Change the greeting and run again.

description.zh: 观察默认不可变变量、常量和可变绑定。
description.en: Compare immutable bindings, constants, and mutable variables.

files.main.xu:
@main

const MAX = 100

fn main() int {
    name := "Xu"
    mut age := 20
    age += 1
    println(name)
    println(age)
    println(MAX)
    << 0
}

exercise.zh: 把 age 的初始值改成 30，观察输出。
exercise.en: Set the initial age to 30 and compare the output.

description.zh: 整数运算、取余和比较表达式返回不同类型的值。
description.en: Try integer arithmetic, remainder, and boolean comparisons.

files.main.xu:
@main

fn main() int {
    a := 17
    b := 5
    println(a + b)
    println(a - b)
    println(a * b)
    println(a / b)
    println(a % b)
    println(a > b)
    println(a == b)
    << 0
}

exercise.zh: 修改 a 与 b，比较整数除法和取余的结果。
exercise.en: Change a and b to compare integer division and remainder.

description.zh: 拼接字符串、输出中文，并将整数转换为字符串。
description.en: Concatenate strings, print Unicode text, and convert an integer to a string.

exercise.zh: 用你的名字替换 name，保留中文输出。
exercise.en: Replace name with your own name and keep the Unicode output.

description.zh: 根据成绩选择分支；修改 score 查看不同结果。
description.en: Choose a branch based on a score. Change score to explore the results.

exercise.zh: 依次把 score 改为 95、70、40，查看各个分支。
exercise.en: Try scores of 95, 70, and 40 to exercise every branch.

description.zh: 使用 start:end 区间匹配，区间包含起点、不包含终点。
description.en: Match a start:end range, including the start and excluding the end.

exercise.zh: 把 age 改为 12、13、20，观察区间的边界。
exercise.en: Try ages 12, 13, and 20 to explore the range boundaries.

description.zh: 用 for 累加，用 while 倒数，观察两种循环。
description.en: Accumulate a sum with for and count down with while.

exercise.zh: 把累加范围改为 1:11，计算 1 到 10 的和。
exercise.en: Change the range to 1:11 to sum the numbers 1 through 10.

description.zh: 用 -> 跳过偶数，用 <- 在到达上限时退出循环。
description.en: Use -> to skip even values and <- to leave the loop at a limit.

exercise.zh: 修改退出条件，看看哪些奇数还会输出。
exercise.en: Change the exit condition and see which odd numbers remain.

description.zh: 从入口文件调用同目录的 math.xu，理解函数参数与返回。
description.en: Call math.xu from the entry file to explore function parameters and returns.

exercise.zh: 在 math.xu 增加一个乘法函数，再从 main.xu 调用。
exercise.en: Add a multiplication function in math.xu and call it from main.xu.

description.zh: 递归函数需要终止条件；这里计算 6 的阶乘。
description.en: A recursive function needs a base case. This computes factorial of 6.

exercise.zh: 计算 factorial(7)，并保留 n <= 1 的终止条件。
exercise.en: Compute factorial(7) while keeping the n <= 1 base case.

description.zh: 读取数组长度和索引，并用循环计算数组元素之和。
description.en: Read array length and an indexed value, then sum the elements.

exercise.zh: 给 numbers 增加一个元素，再运行求和。
exercise.en: Add a value to numbers and run the sum again.

description.zh: 枚举成员可以携带数据，match 可以拆解这些字段。
description.en: Enum variants can carry data, which match can destructure.

exercise.zh: 修改 Rgb 携带的三个值，观察 match 解构后的输出。
exercise.en: Change the three Rgb values and inspect the destructured output.

description.zh: 在 counter.xu 定义计数器，在 main.xu 使用它并修改状态。
description.en: Define a counter in counter.xu, then use and update it from main.xu.

exercise.zh: 在 main.xu 再调用一次 counter.inc()，观察状态变化。
exercise.en: Call counter.inc() once more in main.xu and observe the state.

description.zh: 容量为 2 的信道保存两个整数，接收后相加。
description.en: Store two integers in a channel with capacity 2, then receive and add them.

exercise.zh: 修改发送的两个整数，查看接收后的和。
exercise.en: Change the two sent integers and inspect their sum.

description.zh: 把任务函数放进 worker.xu，启动三个协程并通过信道汇总结果。
description.en: Put the task in worker.xu, launch three coroutines, and collect their results through a channel.

exercise.zh: 在 worker.xu 修改每个 worker 的计算规则。
exercise.en: Change each worker’s calculation in worker.xu.

description.zh: 生产者发送数字，平方协程处理后送入输出信道。
description.en: A producer sends numbers to a coroutine that squares them and forwards the results.

exercise.zh: 把 square 中的平方改为加倍，查看流水线输出。
exercise.en: Replace squaring with doubling and inspect the pipeline output.

description.zh: 通过 xu f() 语法启动轻量协程并发执行任务，借助 chan 信道收发数据并安全同步。
description.en: Launch lightweight coroutines using xu f() and synchronize results through a typed channel.

expected.value:
协程 #1 运行中...
协程 #2 运行中...
协程 #3 运行中...
汇总结果: 60

exercise.zh: 修改 worker 的计算，再查看协程汇总结果。
exercise.en: Change the worker calculation and inspect the combined result.

description.zh: 从最小入口开始，创建自己的文件与程序。
description.en: Start with a minimal entry point and add your own files and program.

exercise.zh: 添加 println，或新建同目录的辅助函数文件。
exercise.en: Add println, or create a sibling file with helper functions.

description.zh: 把入口、定价逻辑和项目说明分开，完成一次商品结算。
description.en: Separate the entry point, pricing logic, and project notes to calculate a checkout total.

files.notes/README.md:
# Checkout project

main.xu is the entry point. pricing.xu owns subtotal and discount calculations.
Both Xu files belong to the same package and run together in the browser.

Try changing the quantity, or apply a discount larger than the subtotal.

exercise.zh: 把数量改为 5，再尝试大于商品总价的优惠金额。
exercise.en: Change the quantity to 5, then try a discount larger than the subtotal.

description.zh: 在一个程序中组合 if、match、while 和 for。
description.en: Combine if, match, while, and for in a single program.

exercise.zh: 改变 age 与倒数起点，比较分支选择和循环输出。
exercise.en: Change age and the countdown start to compare branches and loops.

description.zh: 断言验证程序假设；将 25 改为其他值可观察失败诊断。
description.en: Check an assumption with assert. Change 25 to see a failure diagnostic.

exercise.zh: 把断言中的 25 改为 24，观察失败，再改回正确值。
exercise.en: Change 25 to 24 to see an assertion failure, then fix it.

description.zh: 这个示例会编译失败：在借用仍被使用时修改原值。删除 number = 9 后重新运行。
description.en: This intentionally fails: a value is changed while its borrow is still in use. Remove number = 9 and run again.

expected.value: error: cannot assign to 'number' because it is borrowed

exercise.zh: 删除 number = 9，重新运行，观察诊断消失。
exercise.en: Remove number = 9 and run again to resolve the diagnostic.
